description: Connects this chat to the host's own WordPress site. Take it when the host wants to work on their real site, for example "Everything is set up, now connect my page." It needs the session id and the address, and it creates a link that the host opens and approves in their own browser. Until they approve, nothing is connected, and no password is seen or stored. The approved connection is kept on this connector, encrypted, so a restart does not end it, and a new sign-in replaces the old one. Words hosts use: connect WordPress, my site, approve, sign in

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

url.description: The WordPress address (seite). With was=handoff: the host's WordPress address to point the handover link at.
